notes.title: Small bugfix update
notes.content: Fixed a somewhat rare inconsistent startup crash.

notes.title: The Memory Machine is out now!
notes.content:
We are very excited to release The Memory Machine on Steam! A heartfelt THANK YOU goes out to all our friends and supporters who have kept us going over the last 2 years – it has been a longstanding dream of ours to create and publish a game, and your support enabled us to cross the finish line.

We sincerely hope you enjoy your journey with Arthur & friends as he investigates the Greenfolk forest and the town’s past!

- Creature Games
